nodes.title: Kevin Spacey Face Mask – Fancy Dress Cardboard Costume Mask
nodes.descriptionHtml:
Bring a famous face to a comedy night with this Kevin Spacey face mask, printed on sturdy card and cut to shape. Great for photo booths, surprise birthdays and anyone who loves a bit of fancy dress.

Kevin Spacey Card Face Mask for Parties

Printed in full colour on 350gsm silk card and cut to shape, the mask comes with the eye holes already cut out, plus elastic and sticky tabs for a quick fit. Need a face we don't stock, such as the groom or a friend? Send us a photo and we'll make a custom mask.

Why you'll love it

  • Semi-waterproof finish, so it copes with spilt drinks and outdoor parties
  • Pre-cut eye holes, with elastic and sticky tabs included
  • Full-colour digital print for a sharp, recognisable face
  • Posted flat in a board-backed envelope to keep it crease-free
  • Full A4 size (297 x 210 mm), so it covers an adult face

Size & details

  • Size: 297 x 210 mm (A4), a full adult-size face
  • Material: 350gsm silk card, full-colour digital print
  • Finish: semi-waterproof
  • Fit: one size for adults; elastic and sticky tabs included
  • Pre-cut eye holes; cut to the shape of the face
  • Packaging: board-backed envelope

Delivery

Printed in our UK workshop and posted to you. Dispatch and postage options are shown at checkout.

Order one for a fancy dress night out, or buy a few so the whole group can turn up as Kevin Spacey.

Please note

This is an unofficial novelty product made for fun and fancy dress. Kevin Spacey has not endorsed, sponsored or approved this product, and Foxy Printing has no connection with them. The name is used only to describe the design.
